"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/letter-case-permutation/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

784. Letter Case Permutation

Given a string s, you can transform every letter individually to be lowercase or uppercase to create another string.

Return a list of all possible strings we could create. Return the output in any order.

Example 1:

Input: s = "a1b2"
Output: ["a1b2","a1B2","A1b2","A1B2"]

Example 2:

Input: s = "3z4"
Output: ["3z4","3Z4"]

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 12
    s consists of lowercase English letters, uppercase English letters, and digits.
"""


class Solution:
    def letterCasePermutation(self, s: str) -> List[str]:
        res = []

        def backtrack(i: int, path: List[str]) -> None:
            if i == len(s):
                res.append("".join(path))
                return

            if s[i].isalpha():
                # lowercase branch
                path.append(s[i].lower())
                backtrack(i + 1, path)
                path.pop()
                # uppercase branch
                path.append(s[i].upper())
                backtrack(i + 1, path)
                path.pop()
            else:
                path.append(s[i])
                backtrack(i + 1, path)
                path.pop()

        backtrack(0, [])
        return res


sol = Solution()

print(sol.letterCasePermutation("a1b2"))  # ["a1b2","a1B2","A1b2","A1B2"]

assert sorted(sol.letterCasePermutation("a1b2")) == sorted(
    ["a1b2", "a1B2", "A1b2", "A1B2"]
)
assert sorted(sol.letterCasePermutation("3z4")) == sorted(["3z4", "3Z4"])

assert sorted(sol.letterCasePermutation("1")) == ["1"]
assert sorted(sol.letterCasePermutation("a")) == ["A", "a"]
assert sorted(sol.letterCasePermutation("A")) == ["A", "a"]
assert sorted(sol.letterCasePermutation("aa")) == ["AA", "Aa", "aA", "aa"]
assert sorted(sol.letterCasePermutation("a1a")) == ["A1A", "A1a", "a1A", "a1a"]
